$comment: ts.device is one hour in the future, ahead of ts.server. A gateway with a bad clock. DECIDED 29 Aug 2026 (Q14a, ADR-003 D9): stats-input rejects this with 400 and the field-level code clock_skew_exceeded, metered as records_clock_skew_rejected. The tolerance is stats.input.validation.max-clock-skew, default PT5M; this record is an hour out, so it is well past it. The record stays SCHEMA-VALID on purpose - the check compares ts.device against ts.server, which JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot express - so the expectation is carried by $expect and asserted by validate-fixtures.py rather than by the schema.
